rationale: The exchange has moved from broad positions to site-level economic tests, but the core conflict remains unresolved: labour, state, and governance actors still reject closures and compulsory redundancies while management, owners, and investors still insist those instruments may be necessary. The last two rounds show repeated restatement with some clarification, but no substantive narrowing of the incompatible red lines, so a targeted intervention is needed rather than simple continuation.
